title: Idea Boost canvas interaction inventory (read-only audit)

baseline.method: git fetch origin develop then git archive; code/test inspection; no production modifications

verification.note: Static code/test inspection only. Listed test sources are not claims of successful execution.

prStates.head: 0ff7169394c5f0e29b4248b26be5b622fc9a6d64
prStates.reason: Toolbar may substantially alter route and specification; defer integration.

canonicalRecommendation.machineModel: Optional generated index of stable operation IDs + evidence/status from canonical Markdown; if a full JSON model is chosen, select one authoritative source and generate its other representations.
reasons: PRD already delegates detailed behavior to docs/product; docs/README forbids duplicate canonical rules.
Keep phase/role/source IDs machine readable; do not import draft JSON into runtime as second authorization authority.
Promote stable executable cross-boundary enum/schema to contracts only when implementation is explicitly approved; RoomDO remains authorization truth.
FigJam is a visual projection of stable interaction IDs, status, source links and scenarios; not a second mutable specification.
CONTEXT.md is glossary only. ADR only for hard-to-reverse consequential tradeoff such as #0004, not every tool UI choice.

inputPrecedence.behavior: text handles Space/Delete/Enter; note Escape commits and stops bubbling; group-name Escape cancels
own UI action; menus/popovers avoid canvas hit area. Child can stop event; screenshot/real pointer tests needed for transparent wrappers.
adopt pointer handler bypasses canvas pan capture for adopt target; click/drag distinction remains4px
capture-first pan stops note pointerdown, including note surface; does not start note move
existing sticker click/move/remove wins over adding a vote; keyboard selected-stamp Enter/Space consumes before normal Space pan
single selection at pointerdown, drag after4px if movable, second stationary click edits if allowed
group visual frame pointer-events-none; true background drag pans; short blank click clears selection

operations.title: 付箋を1枚選択
operations.result: selectedNoteIdに1枚だけ保持。付箋はpointerdown時点で選択し、ドラッグでその付箋を動かす。
caveats: キーボードfocusと固定選択は別。共同選択ではない。
Selection ID is local, but selecting eligible shared note also sends persisted bring-to-front; see note.bring-to-front.

operations.title: 選択を解除
operations.trigger: blank click / Escape / phase-revision change / disconnect / adopt-mode start
operations.target: blank canvas, private tray blank, non-editing keyboard
operations.result: 空白クリックは4px未満の移動だけ解除。背景パン・HUD操作・focus移動は選択を保持。
caveats: textarea Escapeは保存して編集終了しstopPropagation。全画面一律のcancelではない。

operations.title: 矩形/複数選択
operations.target: movable shared notes on normal canvas
operations.result: 枠が触れた付箋を選択。Shiftで追加/解除。枚数と選択枠。
caveats: current state is single selectedNoteId; no selection tool, marquee, or selectedNoteIds found. Human prototype validation belongs #283.

operations.title: 選択した付箋を一括移動
operations.result: 相対位置を保持、相手へ一貫同期、失敗で一部のみ残さない。
caveats: Bulk delete and bulk grouping explicitly excluded from #284. Atomic multi-note command absent in develop.

operations.title: 空白から画面を移動
operations.permission: personal camera; independent of note mutation permissions
operations.result: カメラだけ移動。背景の4px以上の移動は選択解除しない。
caveats: current default background drag is PAN, directly contradicts proposed initial select-mode background marquee. Native touch/pinch usability not runtime-tested in this audit.

operations.title: Space/中ボタンで画面移動
operations.permission: personal camera; capture phase before note drag
operations.result: 子のpointerdown伝播を止めてパンと付箋移動の同時開始を防止。キー入力のSpaceはtextarea/input/select/contenteditableで奪わない。
caveats: Persistent hand tool and H/V tool shortcuts are NOT implemented. Voting Space is consumed first for stamp.

operations.title: ホイールでパン/ズーム
operations.result: 通常wheelはdeltaX/deltaYパン。Ctrl/Metaはpointer位置中心ズーム。ShiftかつdeltaX=0はdeltaYをXにも使う。
caveats: Shift+vertical wheel currently changes BOTH x and y, not horizontal-only. Native touch pinch handler not found; browser-generated ctrl-wheel gesture may zoom.

operations.title: 表示倍率/全体表示
operations.trigger: minus, percentage, plus, fit buttons; focus controls + arrows/PageUp/PageDown
operations.result: 1%〜400%、1.25倍刻み、100%reset、HUDを避けて全体fit。方向キーは80px、Pageはviewport高80%。
caveats: 矢印キーは表示操作HUDにfocusがある時だけ。付箋keyboard nudgeではない。

operations.title: マイ付箋を作成
operations.permission: each phase Step1; author only; connected
operations.result: 追加後に選択とtextarea focus。応答待ちに別textareaへ戻ったならそちらの入力focusを優先。
caveats: Double-click canvas / global N / insert menu creation not found.

operations.title: 付箋本文を編集
operations.trigger: second click on already selected note; Enter; printable character
operations.permission: Step1 own private; Step2 private author/shared all members; not excluded/disconnected
operations.result: 選択済みの文字キーは本文末尾へ文字追加して編集開始。blur/Escapeで編集確定、IME compositionは中断させない。
caveats: Escape means commit for note text, cancel/revert for group-name text; spell explicitly. Draft recovery handled separately.

operations.title: 選択付箋の文字サイズ変更
operations.permission: same edit permission, no excluded note; Step1 shared note disabled
operations.result: 12〜24px/1px、初期14。RoomDO保存で全員へ反映、幅200px/高さ伸張。
caveats: Historical #335 originally asked room-wide slider; current policy is per-note controls. Zoom is separate personal view.

operations.title: マイ付箋を削除
operations.trigger: Backspace OR Delete while note surface focused, not editing
operations.result: onDelete(note.id) immediately when canDeleteNote. Editing textarea receives normal text deletion. Shared notes have no reachable delete UI in current step matrix.
caveats: Closed #210 asks Backspace must NOT delete whole private note: https://github.com/engineer-first/idea-boost/issues/210. Current implementation and test deliberately do. Resolve intended requirement before copying into canon.
No general delete Undo found.

operations.title: 共有付箋を移動
operations.result: 掴み位置を保持。サーバー先勝ちlockを取った接続だけ更新。禁止工程/確定後は動かない。
caveats: No arrow-key note movement found. Waiting/denied drag must not optimistically move without lock.

operations.title: 私有付箋を共有
operations.trigger: drag private note across into shared board
operations.permission: Step2 of each phase, connected; sender author
operations.result: ボード領域に入ったpointermove時にpublishを送信し、続けてdrag開始/位置更新。クリック/Enterでは共有しない。
caveats: IMPORTANT: not deferred until drop. Pointer cancellation after crossing may leave note shared at last accepted server position. Canonical must not claim drop-before-sharing privacy.

operations.title: 共有付箋をマイ付箋へ戻す
operations.trigger: drag own shared note onto dock then pointerup
operations.result: dock hoverではreturning ghostと挿入位置だけ。pointerup時にunpublish。範囲外drop/cancelは非公開化しない。
caveats: Ordinary shared lock is released on dock entry; phase3 private-map lock persists until pointerup. This differs from publish timing.

operations.title: マイ付箋の並び替え
operations.permission: reachable only when canMoveNote (Step2); Step1 UI passes canMoveNote=false
operations.result: 挿入placeholderと端auto-scroll、privateOrderをlocalで更新。
caveats: Persisted cross-reload private ordering not established; local state order exists. Do not call this universal all-step reorder.

operations.title: 近づけてまとまりを作る
operations.permission: group edit only 1-3; group display 1-3 onward
operations.result: Displayed frame recalculates on note render (including drag movement). Stored membership reorganizes only on successful note:drag:end or changed direct note:move at1-3, not each intermediate drag:move. Clusters use rectangle gaps <=60px on both axes; >=2 notes and16px padding.
caveats: Domain grouping is not temporary UI multiselection. Single group may be rendered as combined frame with other persistent groups.
Stored groups can split/delete when membership falls below2; ungrouped notes join dominant group. Visual combined frame is not equal to stored group identity.
No server atomic multiselection exists. Future partial group movement requires explicit membership recomputation boundary.

operations.title: グループへ名前を付ける/改名
operations.trigger: click group label or Enter/Space; type; Enter/blur
operations.result: temp group label submit creates persistent group; existing updates name. Nonempty trimmed max50. Escape reverts.
caveats: No generic group CRUD toolbar or explicit ungroup menu found. Background frame has pointer-events-none in develop.

operations.title: グループ枠を掴んで一括移動
operations.result: Unmerged implementation locks all captured notes, same delta, compact movement payload, 60sec server lease, atomic persistence.
caveats: Closed without merge 2026-10-04 02:37:52Z; author says future toolbar may radically change route/spec.
#484 scope is specification only: https://github.com/engineer-first/idea-boost/issues/484
Proposal conflicts with #284 blank-drag marquee. Do not silently select one.

operations.title: 投票シールの種類を選ぶ
operations.trigger: palette click/native button keyboard; choose same kind toggles off; Escape exits
operations.result: subjective1, objective3. Chosen kind follows mouse pointer; touch uses no cursor preview. Out-of-quota/connection change exits stamp mode.
caveats: No need to add text walls: existing palette supports small help/status, remaining, shapes.

operations.title: シールを貼る
operations.trigger: palette drag/drop; selected kind then note click; Enter/Space on focused note
operations.result: 1票追加、付箋内0〜1相対座標。keyboard path uses center through default callback. Multiple objective votes on same note allowed.
caveats: Blank/group background is not a vote target. Existing sticker click does not place another vote.

operations.title: 貼付票を付け替える
operations.trigger: drag own sticker onto same/different note
operations.permission: voting step; connected, no remaining quota requirement
operations.result: stickerId保持して移動。invalid blank drop leaves original. Excluded target rejected/notified.
caveats: No keyboard-only move command found; remove+place is accessible alternative but not same operation.

operations.title: 票を取り消す
operations.trigger: own sticker click/native button keyboard OR drag onto palette
operations.result: 1票取り消してremaining回復。drag suppresses click double-action; invalid drop preserves vote.
caveats: Votes are separate domain actions, not board Ctrl+Z Undo.

operations.title: 投票結果を読む
operations.permission: all members result steps; individual votes hidden during voting
operations.result: 主観/客観別シール群と数。candidate exclusion may omit candidate ranking; no result modal.
caveats: Weighting subjective5/objective1 remains, but current display is types/counts.

operations.title: 2軸で相対評価
operations.result: lower-left0,0 upper-right100,100; coordinates clamped0..100 and saved; free continuous plane, not categorical quadrants. Bounds rendering clamps note card inside plane when possible.
caveats: Axes labels fixed. No axis rename/swap/custom measure controls found. Do not auto-arrange because positions are evaluation.

operations.title: 2軸マップの広さ変更
operations.permission: current host only3-2/3-3; connected, initialized, no active map drag
operations.result: 0..15 levels;1600x900 base;1.1 growth per dimension. Initial level by aggregate private count, capacity12. All members see size change; personal camera stays.
caveats: Distinguish shared map size from personal zoom. No resize controls3-5 despite note movement permitted there.

operations.title: 候補外/復帰
operations.trigger: hover/focus/local selection/touch context affordance; right click/Shift+F10 menu
operations.result: Local optimistic candidate state; pending blocks same note and host decision/progress; confirms with source operationId. Excluded notes dim, stay visible/movable, keep content/votes/group/current position.
caveats: Only candidate action context menu; no general canvas context menu.

operations.title: 候補除外を元に戻す
operations.trigger: confirmed exclusion toast Undo; bulk restore action
operations.target: only still-excluded notes originating from same operation
operations.permission: current host, same undecided result phase, connected
operations.result: Undo restores candidate state only; later position/text/other decisions untouched; stale tokens cannot revert another tab newer candidate changes.
caveats: No generic canvas undo/redo stack or Ctrl/Cmd+Z board command found. Native textarea undo is browser behavior, not shared-domain undo.

operations.title: 採用する1枚を確定
operations.trigger: host enters adopt mode; click candidate (not drag release)
operations.permission: host only undecided result step, no pending candidate mutation
operations.result: click immediately commits without extra dialog; drag remains movable, no adoption on drag/cancel/blank/excluded. Candidate actions hidden. Escape exits mode.
caveats: Selection for adopting is separate mode from normal local single-note selection and proposed marquee.

operations.title: 参加者カーソル表示
operations.result: normal name/color cursor persists with note drag; no extra moving badge. Coordinates use canvas world or map normalized coordinates; map margins allowed for presence only.
caveats: Do not show or send private-area/touch positions. Individual toggle absent by explicit current doc.

operations.title: ペン/描線
operations.result: 議論で候補を指し示す/課題を図で説明するため、試作→人の操作検証→仕様/Issue確定。
caveats: No stroke model/messages/toolbar implementation found. Eraser, persistence, author/role, attachment-to-note, touch-vs-stylus, vote-stage visibility, undo all unresolved.

operations.title: ステップ移行時の自動整列
operations.permission: Issue285 open; acceptance itself to be evaluated
operations.result: overlap resolution while retaining groups; never auto-move phase3 evaluation. Server atomic phase+layout update required.
caveats: Do not treat proximity group-reorganization as auto-layout. Not included #284/#455.

operations.title: 共有付箋を前面へ
operations.trigger: ordinary selection of eligible shared note / successful movement
operations.permission: canMoveNote; connected; not pending candidate; no active remote drag
operations.result: selection invokes note:bring-to-front and RoomDO persists stack_order for all clients. Excluded/readonly/voting selection does not send it. Active and pending drag temporarily front locally.
caveats: Do not equate local selectedNoteId with zero shared-state side effects. No send-to-back/stack-order menu found.

operations.title: 操作の中断とEscape
operations.result: Pointercancel cancels note drag with no new final coordinate, clears vote drag and pan. Escape clears selection/adopt/stamp, note-text Escape commits, group-name Escape reverts.
caveats: No Escape-to-active-note-drag or Escape-to-voteStickerDrag cancellation wiring found. Do not claim universal Escape cancellation.

operations.title: 送信待ち/使い切り/失敗
operations.trigger: vote mutation pending, acknowledgement, rejection, connection state
operations.target: palette remaining and own vote stickers
operations.result: Optimistic note votes/counts with operation IDs; UI distinguishes waiting vs confirmed exhaustion, reads status politely, exhausted new-vote buttons disabled while existing sticker move/remove remains possible.
caveats: Operation acknowledgements and reconnect need server inventory; no result modal reintroduction.

operations.title: 付箋操作の可否表示
operations.target: left-bottom static 編集/移動/削除 icons and circles/crosses
operations.result: Three informational labels with tooltips, no action buttons. Does not take current selected note/author/visibility/connection into account.
caveats: Step1 indicator can say edit/delete allowed while revisited shared note is readonly. Canonical should model per-target permission rather than copy this coarse indicator.

contradictions.summary: #210 forbids Backspace whole-note delete, current NoteCard + tests require Backspace delete
contradictions.resolution: Ask/record intended key rule; do not silently call closed issue proof of implemented acceptance.

contradictions.summary: sprint-flow common rule still equates host with creator, same document now defines mutable host; CONTEXT distinguishes
contradictions.resolution: Use current RoomDO host and amend stale wording when doc edit authorized.

contradictions.summary: use-room-board-interactions comment forbids result-step movement, actual getBoardPermissions override allows before decision
contradictions.resolution: Code/test/#455/sprint-flow121 are current; stale comment must not enter canon.

contradictions.summary: Shared drag-and-drop matrix combines publish and shared move, despite distinct stage/author/timing rules
contradictions.resolution: Split machine operations publish,unpublish,move; retain linked phase matrix not duplicated conflicting prose.

contradictions.summary: #284 blank drag marquee vs #484/#491 group-blank drag bulk move; current blank drag pan
contradictions.resolution: Explicit target×active-tool×modifier priority decision; no resurrection of closed PR defaults.

contradictions.summary: Touch uses pointer drag but no explicit two-finger pinch/gesture ownership handler found
contradictions.resolution: Specify desired gesture policy and validate real touch; do not claim full Miro/FigJam parity.

contradictions.summary: Text says drag-and-drop sharing; actual share commits on entry and unshare commits on release
contradictions.resolution: Document current commit boundary; changing it is a behavior decision, not merely copy.

contradictions.summary: #506 body says Draft and #491 body says awaiting approval, but API says merged/closed-unmerged respectively
contradictions.resolution: Use fresh PR metadata+commit baseline; prose test records remain historical.

contradictions.summary: Escape clears mode/selection but no active gesture cancellation wiring found. Not a proven defect until intended contract chosen.
contradictions.resolution: Define explicit escape ladder; text commit, menu cancel and gesture cancel must not conflict.

contradictions.summary: BoardOperationMatrix displays phase-only canEdit/canMove/canDelete, not actual selected target permissions.
contradictions.resolution: Machine schema dimensions need phase,role,visibility,ownership,exclusion,decision,connection and lock.

contradictions.summary: sprint-flow lines171-174 still says WS gate extension table lives in Discussion36, while docs/README and PRD say repository is canonical and Wiki not updated.
contradictions.resolution: Keep implementation contracts/code authoritative, use discussion as historical evidence; avoid new independent rule canon.

mustDecideBeforeImplementation: Define global tool state and precedence: select/hand/pen vs vote-stamp/adopt mode, overlay/text focus, modifiers.
Specify true canvas blank vs group interior blank vs object surface; proposed marquee must not silently invoke group drag.
Choose group bulk move relationship with temporary selection; #491 center-in-bounds vs #284 rectangle-touch semantics differ.
Determine scope of multi-select in map/private/locked/excluded/read-only phases; #284 explicitly leaves map/private behavior for prototype.
Define toolbar persistence per phase/local tab, temporary Space return, Escape cancel ladder and selected-set retention.
Define multi-drag atomicity, conflict owner, invalidation, no partial commit, interruption semantics and recovery.
Decide keyboard-only equivalent for share/return/move without accidentally undoing approved drag-only product choice.
Pen is research only: own model, phase/privacy visibility, synchronization, persistence, delete/undo, relationship with moving notes not resolved.
Resolve Backspace/#210, relative-evaluation invariants, and new toolbar first-view clutter using human task observation.

issues.283: Human prototype usability validation for pen/multiselection; closes only after specification and follow-up issues.
issues.284: Selection/hand toolbar+rectangle and relative bulk move implementation; excludes bulk delete/group.
issues.484: Specification only group-background move, membership and phase scope undecided.
issues.491: Closed unmerged alternative implementation; preserve evidence, do not import as current.
issues.455: Settled single-selection/movement/candidate rules; explicitly excludes284/285; do not reopen settled vote-step freeze.
issues.418: Closed umbrella; remaining full operation matrix intent should be reconciled rather than duplicated.
issues.285: Open optional transition auto-layout, not approved canonical behavior.
issues.297: Closed evaluation overlap validation; must not move evaluation positions automatically.

glossary.selection: 本人だけの一時的対象集合。currentは1枚、proposalは複数。
glossary.domainGroup: 共有盤面の意味的な付箋分類/名前/所属。selectionとは別。
glossary.personalCamera: 本人だけの表示倍率・視野。
glossary.evaluationPosition: 全員に保存共有する価値/実現可能性の0〜100座標。
glossary.candidateExclusion: 削除せず採用/投票母集団から外す。
glossary.host: 現在の進行権限を持つ参加者。creatorとは別。

serverConstraints.topic: サーバー権威・共通認可
serverConstraints.current_behavior: WS upgrade時と各メッセージ処理時に在籍を検証。現在フェーズの付箋だけ操作可能。privateは作者だけ、sharedは全在籍者に可視。作者・ルームはclient更新payloadから変更不可。採用確定中はdecision:clear以外のboard mutationを拒否。成果公開後はoutcome:publish再送以外のWS更新を拒否。
serverConstraints.documentation_status: 一部明記。横断の操作表はコードに分散。
serverConstraints.spec_action: phase×role×visibility×excluded×decision×connectionの優先順位を1か所に明記する。
verification_scenarios: 非メンバーが旧socketで変更
hostでも他人のprivate本文を取得・更新
確定後に遅延drag/編集/投票/除外が到着

serverConstraints.current_behavior: Step1は自分のprivateの作成・本文・文字サイズ・削除。全phaseのStep2はpublish/unpublish・本文・文字サイズ・移動・最前面・drag。1-3は移動＋group create/name。3-3は移動＋map resize。投票1-4/2-3/3-4はvote系だけ。決定1-5/2-4/3-5は除外/復帰/一括/採用/取消/移動。map resizeは3-2/3-3だけ。lobbyはboard全拒否。
serverConstraints.documentation_status: 画面対応表はあるがcreate/delete/font-size/bring-front等が省略。
serverConstraints.spec_action: 「内容編集」と作成/削除/見た目/移動を別操作として列挙。Step2ではprivate本文編集可だが新規作成・削除不可。
verification_scenarios: 各14stepで全mutationを許可/拒否表として検証
Step1へ戻ってもsharedは編集不可

serverConstraints.current_behavior: 1秒入力停止またはblurで保存。IME変換中は送らない。本文保存にoperationId・expectedContentRevision・expectedPhaseRevision必須。同じ版の並行保存は先着だけ、後着content-conflict。同じoperationId+user/note/digest/expected版の再送は既存receiptでACK。receiptは本文全文でなくSHA256 digestを保存。
serverConstraints.spec_action: 共同編集をLWWや排他本文編集と誤記しない。先着CAS、保存契機、IME、ACK、conflict後の回収導線を記載。
verification_scenarios: 同一付箋2接続同時編集
A保存中にB追加入力してA ACKが到着
文字サイズ/移動と本文を同時変更

serverConstraints.topic: 未反映文章・再接続回収
serverConstraints.current_behavior: draftはuserId+roomIdをkeyとするsessionStorage。snapshot前は再送しない。ACK未達は3秒毎のcontent-status照会。再接続でacceptedなら整理、unknownで同じ本文版/編集可なら同じ保存要求を再送、phase版のみ変わった場合は新operationで再保存。競合/編集不可/付箋消失/IME中断は自動上書きせず未反映文章で全文確認・コピー。storage読取不能/破損も手動回収表示。
serverConstraints.documentation_status: 詳細仕様未記載。サーバーprivate下書きの保存要件とは区別が必要。
serverConstraints.spec_action: 端末間同期の下書き保存と誤記しない。タブsessionの未反映文章はサーバーprivate削除後も回収対象になり得る。自動merge/overwrite/全文undoなし。

serverConstraints.current_behavior: Step1/2からのnext/restart-writingはRoomDOに2秒期限のpendingを永続化しphase:save-requestedを全配信。clientは未送信の確定文章を即flush。期限時点で現在host/在籍/phase+revisionを再検証して進行。全員の保存ACK待ちはない。pending中host transfer拒否。通常進行と反復はphase revision一致必須でABA/二重前進防止。
serverConstraints.documentation_status: 保存猶予の詳細未記載。
serverConstraints.spec_action: 2秒の猶予と全員保存保証の違い、期限後の未反映回収、移譲不可条件を追加。

serverConstraints.current_behavior: クリックでは取得せずdrag:startを最初に受理した1接続だけが所有。1接続1drag、同一noteは別tab/同じuserも排他。同じactive idのstart再送は受理。非所有drag move/endは無視、通常moveはowner存在時に拒否。作者でも他socket所有中unpublish不可。本文/文字サイズはdrag lockに阻まれない。
serverConstraints.spec_action: socket単位とuser単位の違い、拒否応答とsilent ignore、font-sizeがlock対象外の点を明記。
verification_scenarios: drag所有中に別人本文編集

serverConstraints.current_behavior: drag:move毎に位置をSQL保存しnote:updatedを送信者含む可視全員へ配信。drag:end(position)は最終座標確定、position:nullは最後に受理済み位置を維持。pointercancel/leave/disconnectでは最後に受理した座標へ収束。drag lockはWS attachmentに保存されhibernate復帰可能。lock自体にTTLは見当たらずend/leave/close/phase/decision等で解放。
serverConstraints.documentation_status: doc主要契約は一致。古いテスト冒頭コメントは矛盾。
serverConstraints.spec_action: 「中断=drag開始前へundo」としない。受理途中座標は確定済み。lock TTL/半開接続のUXは未仕様。
verification_scenarios: 別tabカーソルが残る同一user切断
socket close未検知のhalf-open時の扱い

serverConstraints.current_behavior: 予期しない切断は1/2/4/8秒後、以降8秒のbackoff。openでattemptリセット。sendはOPENでなければfalse、一般message queueなし。退出/解散closeは再接続しない。各接続は現在phaseの可視note・groups・members・phase/revision・host/revision・pending移行・map・decision・carryover・voter completion・timer snapshot受信。reducerは全置換しdrag optimistic/pending vote等を破棄。membershipはWS切断だけでは残る。

serverConstraints.current_behavior: resultのみhostが除外/復帰。除外は本文/票/位置/font/groupを保持。通常移動はexcludedも可能、bring-to-front単独はexcluded拒否。個別UndoはexpectedExclusionOperationId一致時だけ復帰。一括Undoは同operation由来で現在もexcludedのnoteだけ。位置は復帰しない。任意の本文/位置/削除/グループ等の汎用undo protocolはない。
serverConstraints.spec_action: Undoの語は候補外操作に限定。font/position/contentの巻き戻しと混同しない。汎用undo/redoは現行未対応として明記。

別tab復帰→再除外→古いUndo拒否

serverConstraints.current_behavior: group create/nameは1-3の在籍者全員。対象はshared非excludedを2枚以上、name最大50。自動再編成は1-3のmoveとdrag:endのみ（gate上他の起点は1-3不可）。60 world-unit以内の矩形間距離の連結成分。新しい無名clusterは永続groupに自動登録しない。既存named groupは2枚未満で消滅、無所属noteはcluster内の最多所属groupへ入る。rename/createにrevision/CASなし。 drag:moveは位置保存のみ、drag:end(position:null含む)で再編成。cursor:leaveとWS切断では確定位置を再配信するだけでgroup再計算しない。group create/rename UIは楽観更新するが、hook内にerror対応のrollbackはない。
